articles.title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr.’s advisory contract over 1789 Capital’s Polymarket investment
articles.snippet: Trump Jr. joined Kalshi as a strategic adviser in January 2025, helping the prediction market expand its customer base and strengthen its market presence.

articles.title: Jupiter adds Anchorage-backed USDGO to its $1 billion Solana lending platform
articles.snippet: OSL offers a yield on USDGO only to professional investors, but Jupiter said its market lets other holders earn onchain at rates set by borrower demand.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slumps below $72,000 as Nvidia's Huang resigns, interest rates surge
articles.snippet: The Fed continued amping up its hawkishness on Thursday; meanwhile, existing home sales fell to their weakest level in 16 years.

articles.title: MSCI is dropping Strategy from its index, and the exclusion could hit its bitcoin-buying machine
articles.snippet: MSCI’s decision to exclude Strategy from its equity indexes could hamper the company’s ability to buy more bitcoin, according to some analysts.

articles.title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr. advisory role over Polymarket investment: Reuters
articles.snippet: The prediction market operator said the decision was mutual and followed 1789 Capital’s investment in rival Polymarket, denying political considerations.
